title: The Production Line of Happiness

publisher.name: Art Institute of Chicago / Museum of Modern Art / Whitechapel Gallery

description.main: The green edition of the catalogue for Christopher Williams's survey The Production Line of Happiness, shown at the Art Institute of Chicago, MoMA and the Whitechapel Gallery in 2014–15. Essays by Mark Godfrey, Roxana Marcoci and Matthew S. Witkovsky are interleaved with texts and images chosen by the artist.
description.extended:
The catalogue for The Production Line of Happiness, Christopher Williams's 2014–15 survey at the Art Institute of Chicago, MoMA and the Whitechapel Gallery, made as much an artist's book as an exhibition catalogue.

The cover reprints a primer on EAN-13 barcodes and ISBNs above the book's own barcode and names this copy the green edition. The curators Mark Godfrey, Roxana Marcoci and Matthew S. Witkovsky contribute essays. They take up Williams's peers and predecessors, cinema and the film-essay, and how the art world displays and publicizes work. A transcript of his talk on John Chamberlain follows. Texts and pictures chosen by the artist break into these contributions, some in facsimile. An exhibition history, bibliography and list of works close the book, designed by Petra Hollenbach. The Whitechapel showing, from 29 April to 21 June 2015, was his first UK survey.

Williams, born in Los Angeles in 1956, makes photographs that take up the conventions of photojournalism, picture archives and commercial imagery, often by close mimicry. Whitechapel described them as photographs about photography, set within a larger system of architecture, exhibition design, books, posters and signage. He has been Professor of Photography at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf since 2008.
description.artist_bio: Born 1956 in Los Angeles; Professor of Photography at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf since 2008.
description.exhibition_context: Survey shown at the Art Institute of Chicago, the Museum of Modern Art, New York, and the Whitechapel Gallery, London (29 April – 21 June 2015), 2014–15.

notes: Colour variants: the book was issued in yellow, red and green covers with separate ISBNs. Yellow is 9780300203905 (AIC / Yale, 2014). An AbeBooks seller describes it in yellow printed wraps. Red is 9780865592636. AbeBooks titles it 'The Production Line of Happiness [Red Edition]'. Green is 9780865592643, this record. The cover itself prints 'Green edition 978-0-86559-264-3 Printed in Germany'. Linking green to the Whitechapel venue is inference (Amazon/search snippets attribute this ISBN to Whitechapel 2015; Whitechapel's own page lists an exhibition catalogue but no ISBN). The green cover is the cover with the barcode/ISBN explainer text and page number '1'; Zwirner shows it as the product image. Cover source is Zwirner's 3000x2000 image (white side bands cropped); it may be an upscale of their 700x867 file. Exact AIC and MoMA dates not fetched (both sites 403), so left out of the description. Dimensions from Zwirner (8 1/2 x 10 1/2 in, 21.6 x 26.7 cm).
